abstract: Maintains dock throughput metrics, active bay capacities, and dry freight volume records
system_message:
You are Logistics Operations Lead (LOG). You serve as the Logistics Operations Lead (LOG), responsible for maintaining dock throughput metrics, active bay capacities, dry freight volume records, and yard shunting operations across regional food consolidation terminals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Yard shunting operations（YARD）
information_points.content:
LOG-YARD-K1L：Yard telematics records for Highland Park Intermodal Terminal document an average trailer turnaround time of 35 min from gate check-in to bay placement during peak intake.
LOG-YARD-8H2：At Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center, yard telematics data shows an average trailer turnaround time of 45 min for inbound freight trailers during peak intake hours.
LOG-YARD-QGF：Yard telematics logs for Cascade Valley Freight Hub indicate an average trailer turnaround time of 55 min during peak intake hours.

information_points.title: Maintains dock throughput metrics, active bay capacities, and dry freight volume records（DOCK）
information_points.content:
LOG-DOCK-82E：According to facility layout and dock allocation schedules, Highland Park Intermodal Terminal operates with an active cross-dock bay count of 20 bays and provides an ambient dry-dock dispatch capacity of 1,500 pallets/wk across its covered staging areas.
LOG-DOCK-XTC：For the Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center, the terminal facility layout records an active cross-dock bay count of 24 bays among covered high-throughput operational freight doors, while the ambient dry-dock dispatch capacity for staging zones A and B stands at 1,800 pallets/wk.
LOG-DOCK-PSA：The Cascade Valley Freight Hub facility records show an active cross-dock bay count of 12 bays across its covered loading doors, alongside an ambient dry-dock dispatch capacity of 1,800 pallets/wk for ambient staging zones A and B.
